summary: Credit allocated to staging org after Dedicated capacity activation; production invoice not offset
description:
Issue summary: Customer reports a credit that should have offset their March production invoice was created and applied, but the invoice shows no offset. The customer saw a negative adjustment posted to a staging account (staging org) and no corresponding reduction on the production org invoice.

Impact: ParcelFlow AI reports an unexpected charge of $8,320 on their March 1 invoice. This is a paying customer on a Dedicated plan; missing credit could trigger finance escalation and SLA breach if not resolved within 48 hours.

Environment: Dedicated reserved capacity activated during a mid-cycle capacity swap on 2026-02-25. Activity appears to be limited to us-east region. Billing system: billing-sync service v1.6.2; activation workflow: dedicated-activation-job v2.3.

Steps to reproduce / observed flow:
1) Customer activated an additional reserved capacity pool on 2026-02-25 (Org: org-pf-09; staging org: org-pf-stg).
2) Activation workflow created an adjustment credit record for the committed capacity proration.
3) Billing-sync worker emitted an adjustment event and an invoice credit was created in accounting ledger.
4) Customer sees credit applied to org-pf-stg (staging) instead of org-pf-09 (production).
5) Production invoice for March still shows full charge; staging invoice shows offset line-item.

Relevant logs / artifacts: event IDs billing-sync: evt-20260302-88a, activation-job: act-20260225-7f3, ledger-adjustment: ladj-20260302-0912. Attached invoices and customer screenshots provided.

Requested outcome: Move the credit from the staging org to production org or issue an equivalent manual credit against the production invoice and provide an accounting adjustment so ParcelFlow AI billing reflects accurate charges. Also request root-cause analysis and mitigation to prevent recurrence.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Nina Patel (Support): Customer provided invoices (invoice_2026-03-01.pdf) and a screenshot showing the credit on their staging dashboard. Customer says they did not perform any staging activation during the swap window.
2026-03-10 11:02 - Carlos Mendes (Billing eng): Acknowledged. I am pulling ledger and activation-job logs. Requesting org IDs and API keys for both production and staging from customer (masked).

2026-03-11 08:47 - ParcelFlow billing lead (customer): Provided org IDs: org-pf-09 (prod), org-pf-stg (staging). Confirmed dedicated capacity request initiated by their infra team via support flow. Asked for ETA on correction because month-end close is 2026-03-15.

2026-03-11 13:30 - Carlos Mendes (Billing eng): Found mapping anomaly in activation-job: dedicated-activation-job v2.3 used webhook payload that contained 'last_used_key' which for this activation referenced a staging API key. Ledger shows credit ladj-20260302-0912 tagged to org-pf-stg. Preparing manual reversal and reapply workflow; coordinating with finance for invoice adjustment.
2026-03-12 10:05 - Support (Nina): Informed customer we will apply manual credit and update the invoice. Asked them to confirm the preferred credit method (invoice adjustment vs. one-time credit).
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: Activation flow used wrong org mapping (staging API key) when creating the billing adjustment. Evidence: activation-job logs (act-20260225-7f3) show webhook payload 'api_key_id: key-stg-912' and billing-sync associated ledger entry ladj-20260302-0912 points to org-pf-stg. billing-sync v1.6.2 has a known mapping edge-case when 'last_used_key' is present and both staging and prod API keys are in the activation payload. Repro steps reproduced in staging: running dedicated-activation-job with a payload containing both keys assigns ledger credit to the key-owner org. No other infra anomalies detected. Quantify: credit amount $8,320. Accounting shows the ladj entry was posted but linked_org_id == org-pf-stg.
resolution: Workaround applied: Finance issued a manual negative invoice (credit memo CM-2026-0312-175821) for $8,320 to org-pf-09 and voided the staging ledger entry after confirming staging had no charges to offset. Customer invoice corrected and updated PDF attached sent to customer on 2026-03-12. Permanent fix: patch committed to dedicated-activation-job to prefer explicit org_id field when present and to ignore 'last_used_key' for org mapping (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/dedicated-activation/pull/89). Deployment scheduled to canary on 2026-03-15 and full rollout 2026-03-17 after verification. Postmortem and follow-up tasks: schedule end-to-end billing integration test for activation workflow, add alert when ledger credits are applied to low-usage orgs (possible misrouting), and notify finance team of process to reconcile cross-org adjustments.
notes_for_followup: Verify canary metrics for credits post-deploy (billing-sync errors, credit-applied-org mismatch rate)
Confirm finance has posted the adjustment in GL and close with customer after month-end
